plan.notes: This is a long, steadily escalating film with several meaningful turns before the legal resolution, so three brief interventions plus the opening and outro provide pacing without competing with the narrative. The mid-story appearances are separated by substantial acts and avoid the boundary immediately before the payoff.

segments.reason: Establishes the central tension before the story begins and gives the viewer a question to carry into the first act.
Follows the first major investigative turn, allowing a brief pause before the story shifts from the initial reconstruction toward the subject's account.
Creates a compact questioning beat after the most consequential pretrial development and carries tension through the legal proceedings without standing immediately before the payoff.
Marks the shift from the legal resolution to the later growth of the public story, giving the final act room to examine what endured beyond the trial.
Closes on the remaining uncertainty and gives the viewer a final question without summarizing the case or adding a moral.
